parts.title: PART 1: Stack Migration — Nuxt → SvelteKit
parts.description: Full migration of the entire application from Nuxt 4 (Vue 3 + Nitro) to SvelteKit (Svelte 5). Includes all API endpoints, pages, admin dashboard, DB layer, auth, i18n, animations. CSS stays as-is (ported as global CSS or inline). Everything must work end-to-end.

sprints.title: Project scaffold + DB layer + Core config
sprints.description: Init SvelteKit project, install deps, configure Drizzle ORM, port schema + client + seed data, create config system

sprints.title: Server hooks + Auth + Security basics
sprints.description: Port hooks.server.ts (session, CSRF, CSP headers), auth system (login/logout/session), RBAC helpers, CSRF middleware, rate limiting basics

sprints.title: Public API endpoints (all 15+)
sprints.description: Port all public API routes: health, i18n, portfolios, blog, contact, faq, features, settings, pricing, ws (all as +server.ts)

sprints.title: Admin API endpoints (all 27 groups)
sprints.description: Port all admin CRUD routes: users, roles, translations, settings, legal, portfolio, blog, faq, features, contacts, pricing, team, testimonials, clients, health, stats, audit, terminal, ops, monitoring, support-bundle

sprints.title: Server utilities (38 modules)
sprints.description: Port all server/utils/* to lib/server/utils/: accountLockout, admin-rbac, audit, csrf, email, env, fileValidation, logger, password, rateLimit, sanitization, storage/*, api/*, translationCache, etc.

sprints.title: Frontend shell + Layouts + Atoms
sprints.description: Port layouts (default, admin, blank), app.html, +layout.svelte with header/footer/falling letters. Port all 13 atomic components to Svelte

sprints.title: Molecules + Organisms
sprints.description: Port all 21 molecular components and 13 organism components to Svelte 5

sprints.title: All 13 Section components
sprints.description: Port all section components (SectionHero, About, Focus, F22, Contact, Portfolio, Blog, Features, FAQ, Pricing, Team, Testimonials, Clients) + SectionRenderer

sprints.title: Portfolio viewers (4 components)
sprints.description: Port BrandbookViewer, BrandingViewer, CaseStudyViewer, WebsiteViewer + PortfolioLightbox

sprints.title: Pages (public)
sprints.description: Port homepage (onepager index), dynamic [section], blog pages, portfolio pages, legal pages, login page, init page

sprints.title: Admin Dashboard (all 17 pages)
sprints.description: Port all admin pages: dashboard, users, roles, translations, settings, legal, health, logs, portfolios, blog, faq, features, contacts, pricing, team, testimonials, clients + admin layout with sidebar

sprints.title: i18n system + Theme switching + RTL
sprints.description: Port translation loader (typesafe-i18n), content.ts + system.ts, locale detection, theme toggle (light/dark/system), RTL support

sprints.title: Animations + Interactivity
sprints.description: Port GSAP hero intro, scrollReveal (as Svelte action), scrollytelling (Svelte action), Three.js FallingLetters, page transitions, hero parallax

sprints.title: 2FA + File upload + Storage
sprints.description: Port two-factor auth (TOTP setup/verify), file upload endpoints, local/S3 storage providers, image processing with sharp

sprints.title: Integration testing + Bug fixes
sprints.description: Make everything work together: test all endpoints, check all pages render, fix SSR/hydration issues, verify admin CRUD flows

parts.title: PART 2: CSS Migration — Pure CSS → Tailwind
parts.description: Replace the 5-layer Pure CSS system with Tailwind CSS (customized with PM design tokens). Refactor all Svelte components to use Tailwind utility classes. Create custom Tailwind plugin for PM-specific styles.

sprints.title: Tailwind config + Design tokens
sprints.description: Configure Tailwind v4 with PM color primitives (OKLCH auto-calculated), spacing, typography. Create custom plugin for PM-specific utilities (section, container, section-title)

sprints.title: Migrate reset + primitives layer
sprints.description: Replace CSS reset with Tailwind preflight. Map color primitives + typography tokens to Tailwind theme

sprints.title: Migrate skeleton layer (header, footer, nav, mobile-nav, social-nav, bottom-nav)
sprints.description: Refactor Header, Footer, NavLink, NavLinks, SocialNav, hamburger menu to Tailwind classes. Remove skeleton/*.css

sprints.title: Migrate layout + section CSS
sprints.description: Refactor section layout, containers, responsive grid to Tailwind. Remove layout/*.css

sprints.title: Migrate UI layer (forms, buttons, cards, hero, parallax)
sprints.description: Refactor form inputs, buttons, cards, hero styles, parallax layers to Tailwind. Remove ui/*.css

sprints.title: Migrate animations + runtime CSS
sprints.description: Tailwind-ify keyframes, scroll animations, page transitions. Remove animations/*.css. Keep runtime section-specific CSS or convert to Tailwind

sprints.title: Migrate utility layer + cleanup
sprints.description: Convert common utility classes to Tailwind equivalents. Remove common/*.css. Dark mode audit. RTL audit. Verify no dead CSS remains

sprints.title: Visual regression testing
sprints.description: Compare every page/section before and after. Fix any visual discrepancies. Test all themes (light/dark), locales (incl RTL), responsive breakpoints

parts.title: PART 3: Security Hardening — Maximally Secure on SvelteKit
parts.description: Comprehensive security audit and hardening of the SvelteKit application. Migrate all security mechanisms from PM framework and enhance for SvelteKit-native patterns. Target: OWASP Top 10 compliance + 152-ФЗ compliance.

sprints.title: Auth system hardening
sprints.description: Review session management, password policy (scrypt), account lockout, cookie flags (HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite). Implement SvelteKit-native auth hooks

sprints.title: CSRF + CSP + Security headers
sprints.description: Port CSRF double-submit pattern as SvelteKit handle hook. Port CSP with nonces via SvelteKit event loop. All security headers (HSTS, XFO, CORS, COOP, Permissions-Policy)

sprints.title: Input validation + XSS prevention
sprints.description: Zod validation on ALL API inputs, form actions, search params. Sanitize HTML on all user content. Escape HTML in templates. Magic byte file validation

sprints.title: Rate limiting + DoS protection
sprints.description: Port rate limiter. Apply to login, contact, admin endpoints. IP-based + user-based limits. Redis-backed for multi-instance

sprints.title: Audit logging
sprints.description: Port audit logger. Log all security events (login, logout, failed login, CRUD, role changes, 2FA). Structured JSON logs via Pino

sprints.title: 2FA + Backup codes
sprints.description: Port TOTP 2FA (otpauth), QR code setup, backup codes, encrypted secret storage. Verify all flows on SvelteKit

sprints.title: Compliance (152-ФЗ + GDPR)
sprints.description: Verify cookie consent banner works on SvelteKit. Consent proof storage. Privacy policy + Personal Data policy display. DSAR procedure. Data localization (SQLite stays local)

sprints.title: Security audit + Penetration testing
sprints.description: Run security audit (OWASP ZAP or similar). Check all endpoints for vulnerabilities. Review dependency CVEs. Fix all findings

parts.title: PART 4: Performance Optimization — Maximally Fast on SvelteKit
parts.description: Optimize the SvelteKit application for maximum performance: SSR/SSG strategy, bundle optimization, caching, image optimization, streaming, lazy loading, Core Web Vitals targeting 90+.

sprints.title: SSR/SSG strategy + Caching
sprints.description: Configure SvelteKit adapter (Node or static). Set up ISR/SSR/SSG per route. Port Nitro routeRules (ISR for homepage, caching headers for static assets). Redis cache for API if needed

sprints.title: Image optimization pipeline
sprints.description: Port sharp processing pipeline. AVIF/WebP generation on upload. Responsive srcset. Lazy loading (loading=lazy). Thumbnail generation. Optimized image storage

sprints.title: Bundle optimization + Code splitting
sprints.description: Tree-shake unused deps. Code-split large components (Three.js, GSAP, portfolio viewers). Dynamic imports for admin panel. Analyze bundle with vite-bundle-analyzer

sprints.title: Font optimization + Critical CSS
sprints.description: Self-host fonts. Font subsetting (Cyrillic + Latin + Hebrew). Preload critical fonts. Inline critical CSS (first paint). Defer non-critical CSS

sprints.title: Database query optimization
sprints.description: Review all Drizzle queries for N+1. Add proper indexes. Optimize JOINs. Use prepared statements. WAL mode tuning. Connection pooling if needed

sprints.title: Lighthouse audit + Core Web Vitals
sprints.description: Run Lighthouse on all page types. Target: LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, CLS < 0.1. Optimize TTFB, FCP, SI. Fix all performance issues

sprints.title: Progressive enhancement + Offline
sprints.description: Implement progressive enhancement for JS-dependent features. Add service worker for offline support (PWA). App shell caching. Background sync for contact form

sprints.title: Load testing + Production benchmarks
sprints.description: Run k6/artillery load tests. Benchmark API response times. Measure memory usage. Test with production-like data volume. Verify horizontal scaling
